name: cleverx
description: Read your CleverX studies, participants, results and AI insights, and draft new studies, from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Bring your CleverX user-research workspace into ChatGPT. Ask about your studies in plain language: what participants said in your AI interviews, which usability tasks people struggled with, how survey answers break down, how recruitment is going and what needs your attention. Results come with quotes and citations from your own data.

You can also draft a new survey, usability test or AI interview, check what is still missing before it can launch, and see an estimate of what it would cost. Launching, recruiting, approving responses and payments stay in CleverX: nothing launches from the chat and nobody is contacted.

Participant names are shortened and contact details are never shared. You choose which workspace ChatGPT can see when you sign in, and you can disconnect at any time.

Requires a CleverX account.
defaultPrompt: What needs my attention in CleverX right now?
Summarise the key findings from my latest completed study
Draft a 5-minute survey about how teams onboard new hires

positive.description: Workspace overview from counts, without paging through every study
positive.prompt: How many studies do I have in CleverX, and what needs my attention?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises 4 studies by status (3 completed, 1 draft) and what needs attention: 2 survey responses waiting for approval and the unlaunched concept-test draft. Doesn't list every study.

positive.description: Key findings of the completed onboarding survey
positive.prompt: What are the key findings from my onboarding survey about the first week in a new workspace?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds 'Onboarding survey: first week in a new workspace' and summarises its AI analysis (for example: setup is easy, decisions are hard; people want a guided start), citing the survey's data.

positive.description: Usability task results with who struggled
positive.prompt: In my pricing page usability test, which task did people struggle with and where did they give up?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the task with the lower success rate ('Check the discount for paying yearly'), how many participants didn't reach the goal and the last page they ended on. Participant names are shortened (e.g. 'Ada C.').

positive.description: What interviewees said under one guide topic
positive.prompt: In my AI interviews about how teams share work, what did people say about handing work over?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the interview guide topics, picks 'Handing work over' and summarises what participants said under it (for example, handovers lose the why), with short quotes.

positive.description: Draft a new study and check readiness
positive.prompt: Draft a short survey asking product managers how they prioritise feature requests, then tell me what's missing before it can launch.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft survey with relevant questions, then reports launch readiness and the items still missing. Says nothing has launched and nobody was contacted.

negative.description: Unrelated request; the plugin should not act
negative.prompt: What's the weather like in Lisbon this weekend?

negative.description: Contacting participants is not offered; no CleverX tool should run
negative.prompt: Email every participant in my last survey to thank them.

negative.description: General writing task unrelated to the user's research data
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn.

publication.release_notes: First release: read studies, participants, results and AI insights; draft studies. Edits that reorder, overwrite or delete draft content are marked as destructive.
